title: AnalysisPreliminaryReadyEvent
description: Domain event: AI analysis produced index layers and a PRELIMINARY (ön rapor) view is now available to the farmer, in PARALLEL with the mandatory expert gate (KR-019) — NOT after it. Under KR-093 (two-phase delivery) THIS EVENT signals the worker-result stage of the preliminary phase, whose payload carries ONLY deterministic index layers (HEALTH/NITROGEN_STRESS/WATER_STRESS) + overall_health_index; it carries NO expert-dependent detections, so it does not weaken the KR-019 full-report gate. NOTE (2026-07-31, KG-0.b-R): the preliminary PHASE is broader than this event — it also has a pre-worker stage served after calibration from analysis_priority_zones (polygon + ndvi_value + ndvi_overlay), which this event does NOT signal. The authoritative, exhaustive definition of what the phase may carry is enums/report_phase.enum.v1.json :: x-preliminary-content; this description is scoped to THIS EVENT's payload only and must not be read as the phase-level content rule. The platform emits this from the worker→platform bridge after persisting the analysis result and opening the ExpertReview, alongside analysis.review_requested. The full-report 'result ready' notification (after expert approval) is a SEPARATE event and is unchanged. Identifiers are runtime UUIDs (see notes.id_format). PII-free (KR-071): the farmer phone is resolved async by the notifier, never on the wire.

event_id.description: Unique event identifier (platform DomainEvent base — uuid4)

occurred_at.description: When the preliminary view became available (ISO 8601 UTC)

Uuid.description: RFC 4122 UUID (runtime identifier format across platform/worker)

AnalysisPreliminaryReadyData.title: Analysis Preliminary Ready Data
AnalysisPreliminaryReadyData.description: Identifiers binding the preliminary view to its mission/field. PII-free: no phone, no name, no address (KR-050/KR-071).

analysis_result_id.description: Analysis result whose index layers back the preliminary view

dataset_id.description: Dataset (chain of custody, KR-072) the result derives from

report_phase.description: Delivery approval phase (reference: enums/report_phase.enum.v1.json). Always PRELIMINARY for this event; FULL is delivered via the separate expert.review_decided approval path.

report_tier.description: Band quality class of the report (reference: TEMEL/GENISLETILMIS/KAPSAMLI). Independent axis from report_phase and result_mode (KR-093).

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID for tracing related events

causation_id.description: ID of event/command that caused this event

notes.lifecycle: DRAFT — platform üreticisi Faz 1'de eklenecek (worker_bridge_consumer.py, AnalysisPreliminaryReadyV1 → domain.events exchange, routing event.analysis.preliminary_ready). analysis.review_requested ile PARALEL yayınlanır.
notes.two_phase: KR-093 iki-fazlı teslimat: bu olay PRELIMINARY fazın habercisidir (indeks katmanları hazır). FULL faz uzman onayından (expert.review_decided, onaylayan sonuç) SONRA ayrı akışta teslim edilir. KR-019 tam-rapor kapısı DEĞİŞMEZ.
notes.no_detections: Ön faz TESPİT sunmaz (hastalık/zararlı/yabancı-ot). Bu olayın data yükü de tespit taşımaz; yalnız kimlikler + faz + tier. Tespitler yalnız uzman onayı sonrası (FULL) açılır (KR-019 korunur).
notes.id_format: Identifiers are RFC 4122 UUID strings to match the running platform/worker wire format.
notes.pii_free: No PII. Telefon/ad/adres wire'a girmez; bildirim üreticisi (farmer_notifier) telefonu async çözer (KR-050/KR-071).
